title: Why We Remember Beginnings and Endings
short_teaser: People often remember the beginning and end of an experience more clearly than the middle.
story: People often remember the beginning and end of an experience more clearly than the middle. This pattern helps explain why opening moments and final impressions carry unusual weight. Designing an experience well includes paying attention to how it starts and how it closes. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Designing an experience well includes paying attention to how it starts and how it closes. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden.
spark_application: Take one assumption you have been treating as fixed and turn it into three open questions. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
